description: This header file declares helper routines for USB device enumeration, device details retrieval, and interface checking used in the Android ADB (Android Debug Bridge) API on Windows.

methods.name: GetSDKComplientParam
methods.description: Converts access type and share mode enums into SDK-compliant values.

methods.name: EnumerateDeviceInterfaces
methods.description: Enumerates interfaces for a given hardware device info handle.

methods.name: GetUsbDeviceDetails
methods.description: Retrieves detailed data about a specific USB device interface.

methods.name: GetUsbDeviceName
methods.description: Gets the device name for a specific USB device.

methods.name: IsLegacyInterface
methods.description: Checks if a given interface is available via a custom USB driver.
